scope: Fresh verification review of the editor dock, additional-tool route handoff and layer arrangement

findings.title: An undo immediately before a reorder commit is overwritten by stale layer records
findings.cause: The target guard checks page/session identity; _commitOrder then replaces all current layer records with the local widget snapshot. A model update before didUpdateWidget is not detected by _orderRevision.

tests: a reorder before the next frame must not restore a photo edit that was just undone
an actual drag finishing after undo must retain the undone photo geometry

findings.recommendation: Validate the current model revision at commit and apply only order changes against fresh layer records, or reject a stale drag.

findings.title: A second dock More tap during dismissal overlaps sheets and discards the selected tool
findings.cause: The editor route is current again during the reverse animation. The guard permits another _details call while the first is awaiting route.completed; the first handoff is then discarded because the newer sheet owns the route.

proof.test: a second More tap during dismissal must not overlap or discard the chosen tool

findings.recommendation: Keep an editor-owned opening/closing/handoff guard until the outgoing sheet is fully removed and its selected action has been dispatched.

findings.title: Pending thumbnail requests are evicted and started again during fast reverse scrolling
findings.cause: The 32-entry LRU counts pending Futures as ordinary completed cache entries; it can forget a still-running thumbnail request and launch another for the same photo.

proof.test: pending thumbnail requests must coalesce during a fast return scroll

findings.recommendation: Coalesce in-flight requests independently of completed-cache eviction, cap concurrent jobs and discard queued work for closed panels.

limits: Repeated closing released tested controllers and image listeners; this does not prove absence of all device memory leaks. The slow-thumbnail test demonstrates request duplication and pending work, not a measured device OOM.
